description: Sportsbook odds from Covers.com odds screens (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college, WNBA): every listed game with Covers game ID, away/home team, kick-off text and, for each sportsbook shown (e.g. bet365, BetVictor, William Hill, Betway), the away and home price in American, decimal and fractional odds plus Covers' market tag.
